description: EVISUN B0509S-1WR3, SIP-4 1 W 5 V input to isolated 9 V non-regulated output DC/DC module, 112 mA maximum output and 1.5 kVDC/min isolation.
name: b0509s-1wr3

provenance.source: EVISUN B_S-1WR3 series datasheet, C7500906: B0509S-1WR3 electrical limits, package drawing, pin functions, recommended capacitors, minimum load, and isolation rating.

watch_out_for: Pins 1=-VIN and 2=+VIN are the logic-side 5 V input; pins 3=-VOUT and 4=+VOUT are the isolated field-side output. This module is non-regulated: it feeds a field-side 5 V LDO and must not be used as a direct MAX485 supply. Provide 4.7 uF input bypass, the datasheet-recommended output bypass, and at least 10% rated output load; do not bridge input and output returns.
